Technical Support Specialist 100% - Mechanical & Plant Engineering BSA - Bobst Mex SA

Apply now

Do you see technical problems not as an obstacle, but as a challenge? ⚡ With your know-how, you ensure that our machines run reliably worldwide - and contribute directly to the success of our customers. 🚀

Packaging makes an important contribution to our society. They protect products during transport, enable them to be stored, extend their shelf life and provide valuable information about the contents. Bobst is one of the world's leading suppliers of quality equipment and services to packaging and label manufacturers. We support our customers in more than 50 countries, have 14 production facilities and employ over 6,400 people around the world. At our Grenchen site (Switzerland), we develop and produce systems for producing laminated corrugated cardboard - and ensure that these run reliably for our customers worldwide.

YOUR MISSION

- Provide troubleshooting support in the area of electrical and process technology for customers and internal employees
- Coordinate service operations from planning to briefings to debriefing
- Ensure knowledge transfer between service technicians, development and production
- Receive feedback from the field and actively contribute to product and quality improvements
- Support customers and branches directly on site if necessary (travel activity up to approx. 40%)

Requirements

- You have completed training as an automation engineer, electronics engineer, mechatronics engineer, industrial electronics engineer or similar
- Experience in mechanical or plant engineering as well as knowledge of Siemens PLC are a big advantage
- Good knowledge of regulation and control technology

jobs.title: Senior Writing Systems Engineer
jobs.description:
Senior Writing Systems Engineer BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Shape the future of industrial inkjet printing At BOBST, we are redefining the future of packaging through advanced industrial printing technologies. As a global leader in packaging equipment and services, we combine Swiss engineering excellence with digital transformation to deliver high-performance production systems worldwide. To strengthen our R&D team, we are looking for a Senior Writing Systems Engineer who will play a key role in developing and optimizing next-generation industrial inkjet printing systems for demanding production and application environments. Your mission As a senior technical expert, you will own and drive the performance of our writing systems at the heart of our digital printing platforms. You will work on highly complex multidisciplinary challenges involving printheads, fluidics, motion systems, electronics, software, print applications, and industrial process stability to ensure outstanding image quality, robustness, uptime, and production performance in real customer environments. The role requires a strong connection between technology development and real industrial application realities, including substrates, inks, workflows, operator usage, and production constraints. Your mission As a senior technical expert, you will own and drive the performance of our writing systems , at the heart of our digital printing platforms. You will operate at the crossroads of mechanics, electronics, software and fluid physics , ensuring that our machines deliver outstanding print quality, reliability, and industrial performance. 
• Responsibilities Drive innovation & system performace Drive the design and optimization of industrial inkjet writing system architectures.

Define and challenge performance targets related to: printhead behavior,

Act as technical owner from concept to product launch

Ensure alignment between performance, quality, cost and manufacturability

Translate business needs into robust engineering solutions

Develop physical and empirical models (fluid dynamics, drop formation, thermal behavior)

Design and execute advanced experiments (DOE)

Analyze data to improve system behavior and reliability

jobs.title: IoT Technology Director
jobs.description:
IoT Technology Director BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Shape the Future of Connected Packaging Industry At BOBST, we are transforming the packaging world through digitalization, connectivity and data-driven services. Our IoT ecosystem, BOBST Connect , enables customers worldwide to optimize performance, increase productivity and unlock the power of their data. To support our ambitious growth journey, we are looking for an IoT Technology Director to lead the development of our cloud platform, data capabilities and operations teams. This is a high-impact leadership role at the crossroads of technology, innovation and business transformation. You will lead a multidisciplinary organization of more than 40 engineers and specialists and play a key role in defining the future of BOBST's digital solutions. Your Mission As a member of the IoT Leadership Team, you will drive the technology strategy, architecture and delivery of the BOBST Connect platform while partnering closely with the Iot Product Director to bring innovative solutions to market. You will lead teams based in Switzerland and Morocco and report directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO). Key responsibilities Lead and inspire Lead, develop and grow multidisciplinary IoT, Data Science and Operations teams (+40 people).

Foster a culture of agility, collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement.

Coach leaders and technical experts, ensuring the organization is equipped to deliver on its ambitions.

Own the technology roadmap and execution of the BOBST Connect platform together with the Iot Product Director.

Define architecture, technology stack, cybersecurity and cloud strategies that ensure scalability, reliability and performance.

Promote modern engineering practices including Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD and AI-enabled development approaches.

Partner with Product Lines, Business Units and commercial teams to maximize customer value.

Translate business needs into innovative digital solutions and services.

Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Join Our Web-Fed Solutions Team Within the Services & Performance Business Unit, we offer you the opportunity to join our Web-Fed Solutions External Field Service Pool as a Field Service & Commissioning Engineer – Automation & Motion Control. You will be required to travel internationally for 50% to 60% of your working time, often on assignments lasting several consecutive weeks. YOUR MISSION Commission automated production lines in Switzerland and internationally.

Perform retrofit, modernization, and upgrade projects on existing installations.

Independently plan and organize on-site commissioning activities.

Diagnose and resolve complex technical issues related to automation, motion control, electrical systems, and industrial IT.

Program, modify, and optimize automation systems using Siemens TIA Portal and Siemens S7.

Commission and configure drive systems and synchronized motion axes.

Perform troubleshooting interventions both on customer sites and remotely.

Coordinate technical activities with customer teams.

jobs.title: Flagship Event Manager
jobs.description:
Flagship Event Manager BSA - Bobst Mex SA Apply now Want to shape high-impact customer experiences that engage customers and showcase innovation? This role will be located in one of our BOBST entity in EUROPE. As Flagship Event Manager, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of BOBST's flagship customer events, ensuring execution excellence through strong project governance, cross-functional coordination, budget management, and impact measurement. Key 
• Responsibilities Lead the planning and execution of flagship customer events.

Manage event timelines, milestones, and end-to-end delivery to ensure execution excellence.

Establish project governance and prepare and lead steering committee meetings.

Monitor project progress, manage risks and dependencies, and facilitate timely decision-making.

Align and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders, including Product Lines, Industries, Sales, and Regional MarCom teams.

Foster effective collaboration and manage project communications across all involved parties.

Manage event budgets, procurement activities, and agency selection and performance.

Monitor spending and forecasts while ensuring compliance with approved budgets.
